page5.letterText:
My Dear Inchara,

Happy Girlfriend's Day, my love❤️

Even though miles separate us, not a single day goes by without you being on my mind. Distance has only made me realize how deeply I love you and how grateful I am to have someone as amazing as you in my life.

Thank you for being my happiness, my peace, my biggest supporter, and the reason I smile even on the hardest days. Every Video Call, Every call, every message, and every little moment we share means the world to me.

The best part? In just 14 more days, I'll finally get to see you again. I can't wait to hold your hand, look into your eyes, and make up for all the hugs  and kisses we've been missing.

Until then, keep smiling, take care of yourself, drink water and remember that no matter how far apart we are, my heart is always with you.

I love you more than words can ever express. Once again Happy Girlfriend's Day maa❤️

ending.finalNote: Thank you for being the best part of my life
